issues.message: 378 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Interior is well furnished (six beds with slab bedside tables, carpet-free aisle, furnace hearth, chests, barrels, shelves), but the outside is bare: no sills, shutters, boxes or lanterns on any face.
notes.purpose: From outside it reads as a plain cottage; the ward of six red beds only reads through the windows and in the floor view.
notes.depth: Logs, terracotta infill, the beam at y3 and the cobblestone plinth all sit in one plane (x=2/x=8, z=2/z=10); only the eaves and lean-to cast shadows.
notes.roof: The automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm: stairs overhang one block on all four sides (x=1, x=9, z=1, z=11). Steep, slab ridge, dark oak eave row. A 1-block gap under the front ridge at (5,6,1) shows as a dark slot in the front view.
notes.life: Nothing growing and no outside light at L1 (fine for a shell level, but it scores 0).

visual.summary: An 11x13 timber-framed ward with a spruce gable roof, six beds, hearth and a lean-to herb store; the working shell soldiers build first.
problems: Front barge board has a hole under the ridge at (5,6,1) (dark slot in the front view): fill it, e.g. a spruce stair or log end.
Walls are flat: consider pushing the cobblestone plinth or the corner posts one block out, or sills under the windows at y1, so faces get shadow.
Reachability: every room, the ward aisle and the lean-to are reached; only roof slopes, shelf trapdoor tops and the chimney shoulders are not. Fine.

Build one in blocks so it shows in renders and does not depend on the decoration step, e.g. on the front gable face at z=2: red_wool or red_concrete at (5,4,2),(5,5,2),(5,6,2),(4,5,2),(6,5,2) with white_wool/white_terracotta at (4,4,2),(6,4,2) behind it, and keep it in L2 and L3.

Reachability: ward, aisle and lean-to are reached; only roof slopes, shelf trapdoor tops and chimney shoulders are not. Fine.

notes.artefacts: Carlton's note is not met: the 'red cross' is five plain bricks at (5,4,1),(4..6,5,1),(5,6,1). Bricks are reddish-brown with grey mortar, the same block as the chimney stack, and only the two lower corners (4,4,1),(6,4,1) are white; the upper corners are spruce roof stairs, so the top arm sinks into the brown roof. In the front view a plus shape can just be made out, but it reads as brick masonry or a chimney breast, not a red hospital cross; in the iso view and the sheet thumbnails it is only a brick patch. Carlton's note isn't met, so artefacts 0.
notes.purpose: Without a readable red cross it reads as a cottage; only the beds inside show it is an infirmary.
notes.roof: The roof warning is a false alarm: the renders show the roof past the side walls and the front gable projecting over the door.

visual.summary: L1 is the white plaster and dark oak ward with six beds, hearth, herb shelves and the lean-to herb store, now with a brick cross in the front gable.
problems: Carlton's note is not met: the 'red cross' is five plain bricks at (5,4,1),(4..6,5,1),(5,6,1). Bricks are reddish-brown with grey mortar, the same block as the chimney stack, and only the two lower corners (4,4,1),(6,4,1) are white; the upper corners are spruce roof stairs, so the top arm sinks into the brown roof. In the front view a plus shape can just be made out, but it reads as brick masonry or a chimney breast, not a red hospital cross; in the iso view and the sheet thumbnails it is only a brick patch.

Make the cross read as a hospital cross on every level: use a clearly red block (red_wool or red_concrete; untested blocks are only a warning, L2/L3 already carry several) at (5,4,1),(4,5,1),(5,5,1),(6,5,1),(5,6,1), and put it on a full white field: white_terracotta at all four corners (4,4,1),(6,4,1),(4,6,1),(6,6,1) (replace the spruce stairs at (4,6,1) and (6,6,1)), ideally a white border round it, so the cross stands out against white instead of the brown roof.
Outside still bare at L1 (no sills, shutters or plants); optional.
Reachability: ward, aisle and lean-to (and L3 garden) reached; unreached are only roof slopes, shelf/box/canopy tops and chimney shoulders. Fine.
